subject: Sea freight quote: Hamburg to Jebel Ali
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! Could you send me an all-in price in EUR for a port-to-port sea freight shipment from Hamburg (DEHAM) to Jebel Ali (AEJEA)?

The furniture samples will be ready on 2026-11-27. It’s an FCL shipment in 1 x 40ft container, with 6 pieces, a gross weight of 9617 kg and a total volume of 43.5 cbm.

Thanks for taking a look!

Cheers,
Klaus Weidner
Weidner Spielwaren GmbH, Nuremberg
